display_long_description:
# 🛏️ Infinite Bedz

Bed Wars is coming to VR! ⚔️ Build, fight, and defend your bed in Infinite Bedz, where every block you place and every swing of your sword happens with your own hands!

Jump onto floating islands with your team and protect your bed at all costs. As long as your bed is standing, you can keep respawning. But once it's destroyed, your next death is your last!

## 🏃 MOVE YOUR WAY
No joysticks needed! Swing your arms to run, climb walls, and move around the map using smooth arm-based movement. Rush enemy bases, escape close fights, or race back to save your bed!

[media]

## ⚔️ BUILD, DEFEND, ATTACK
Collect resources from generators around the map and use them to buy blocks, weapons, and tools. Build bridges across the void, protect your bed with layers of defenses, and break into enemy bases to destroy theirs!

[media]

## 👥 TEAM UP WITH FRIENDS
Join online multiplayer matches and work together to take down other teams! Rush straight into battle, build a massive bed defense, or sneak into enemy territory while nobody's looking. How you play is up to you!

[media]

## 🎨 STAND OUT
Choose your team color and unlock skins to customize your look! With more skins coming over time, there's always something new to show off.

[media]

## 🏆 WILL YOUR BED SURVIVE?
Build your defenses, grab your sword, and get ready for some chaotic VR battles!

**Protect your bed. Destroy theirs. Be the last team standing. 🛏️⚔️**
[media]
